packages.title: Independent review on greenhouse gas removals: government response — scope and status QA
facts: DESNZ published the government response to the independent review on greenhouse-gas removals on 17 July 2026.
The response concerns how engineered and nature-based removals can assist UK net-zero objectives.
The policy statement describes work on revenue certainty, carbon capture and storage networks, market frameworks and integrity standards.
Policy commitments and market design are not observations of tonnes removed at an individual parcel.
No parcel removal or emission value is inferred from the policy response.
